title: fix(objectql): give a runtime-authored object a metadata-service copy on a kernel with an environmentId, so both MCP doors refuse an object whose API exposure is off
body:
Fixes #23689

Clause-②: no

**reachable: true.** On a kernel built with an `environmentId`, an object whose API exposure was off was served, read and write, through the MCP stdio door and the HTTP MCP data verbs. That covers the real `os dev` (`env_local`) and the single-environment runtime shape the cloud runs. The REST data door on the same boot refused the same objects. The walk reading is comment 6199252355 on the card, posted before any code changed.

The producer is `packages/objectql`. On this kernel shape the `metadata` service is sourced from the artifact and the boot bridge does not run. The copy follow from PR #23687 also returned early here. So the service held no copy of any runtime-authored object, exposed or not, and both gates read that absence as "no declaration". This PR keeps that copy where it is produced, on this shape too. `packages/mcp` and `packages/runtime` are untouched, and so are `ObjectQLPlugin.start()`'s order and the `objectql:drivers-ready` region (PR #23694).

## Step 1: the walk, on base `69351e985a`

**The two shapes.**
- **`os dev` as `env_local`, booted for real:** `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --fresh` from the built CLI. `os dev` takes `resolvedMode = 'standalone'`, so `createStandaloneStack` composes the kernel. That is `MetadataPlugin({ environmentId, artifactSource: local-file })` plus `ObjectQLPlugin({ environmentId: 'env_local', hydrateMetadataFromDb: true, runPlatformMigrations: true })`.
- **The cloud single-environment runtime:** its host (`apps/objectos-ee`) lives in `objectstack-ai/cloud`, outside this session's repository scope, so it was not booted. In this repo the shape is the one `ObjectQLPlugin`'s `hydrateMetadataFromDb` docblock names ("the cloud single-env tenant runtime on Turso"): an `environmentId`, hydration on, and an artifact-sourced service. `createStandaloneStack` composes exactly that for any `OS_ENVIRONMENT_ID`. It was measured in-process with those two plugin options verbatim, at `env_local` and at `env_01walkcloudshape`, and the two read identically.

The in-process harness is PR #23687's door harness with the kernel swapped. It uses the real `MCPServerPlugin` (its `start()` builds the stdio data bridge under `enforceApiExposure`) driven by JSON-RPC `tools/call`. The HTTP leg calls `refuseUnexposedDataAction` (the gate `callData` asks first under the HTTP MCP data verbs) with the kernel's own `metadata` service. The one faked seam is the `sys_api_key` row the stdio principal resolves from.

**Real `os dev`, HTTP MCP door (`POST /api/v1/mcp`, as the seeded admin), base:**

| case | REST `GET /api/v1/data/X` | MCP `query_records` | MCP `create_record` | other |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| (a) created with `apiEnabled: false` | `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` | served (`total: 0`) | served, a row written; the next query returns it | `list_objects` does not name it |
| (b) saved exposed, a row via REST, then turned off | `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` | served, the REST row returned | served, a second row written | `describe_object`: `Object "qa_walk_toggle" not found` |

**In-process, both `environmentId` values, base:**

| case | `metadata.getObject` | stdio door | HTTP gate |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| (a) created off | ABSENT | `query_records` served; `create_record` served, rows 1 to 2 | ALLOWED (query, create) |
| (b) exposed, then off, same boot | ABSENT (absent while exposed too) | served; create wrote a row | ALLOWED |
| (b') exposed, restart, then off | ABSENT | served | ALLOWED |
| (c) then deleted | ABSENT | not listed; `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` 404 | n/a |
| (d) saved off, then a restart | ABSENT | served | ALLOWED |

Reading (d) is not in the card. An object saved off and then hydrated at the next boot has no copy, and no mutation fires for it after boot. So following mutations alone would leave it served.

## The landing point, measured against the alternative

**Can this service take a runtime copy without writing through a loader?** Yes, so the dispatch's fork never came up. `MetadataManager.registerInMemory` sets the in-memory map only, with no loader write and no announce. `unregister` deletes through `datasource:` loaders only, and it is called under PR #23687's three bounds: the mutation says `deleted`, the registry no longer serves the name, and the copy is the runtime-authored one.

**Producer (this PR) vs the gates reading the registry or the stored definition:**

| axis | copy kept at the producer (taken) | gates read the registry |
|:--|:--|:--|
| business need (measured) | Both gates, `list_objects` / `describe_object`, the AI tools and the MCP resources read this one service, and all of them were wrong on this shape. One producer change fixes every reader, and the after-walk below shows it. | It would fix the gates it is written into and leave listing, describing, the AI tools and the resources blind to every runtime object. The gate half alone is about seven sites: `enforceApiExposure`, list, describe and the `get_record` resource reader in `packages/mcp`, plus `refuseUnexposedDataAction`, `listObjects` and `describeObject` in `packages/runtime` (`domains/mcp.ts`). |
| long-term | The service carries one rule on every kernel shape: a runtime-authored object has a current copy. There is no per-shape exception left to rediscover. | The service and the registry would stay disagreeing on this shape, and every new reader of the service would inherit the gap. `IDataEngine` does not declare `registry`, so each site needs an untyped reach-through. |
| AI-safety | `apiEnabled: false` is enforced wherever it is read. That is "declared means enforced" at the producer, with no consumer tolerance. | Readers would differ in which source they trust. That split is how the defect arose. |
| scope | One file: `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, about 60 lines. | Cross-lane (`domain:cli`), two packages, and the dispatch says to stop before writing it. |

## What changed

- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, the copy follow.** `followRuntimeObjectCopy` no longer returns early when `environmentId` is set. A save refreshes the copy before it returns. A delete removes it under the same three bounds. What the follow touches is unchanged: only an object whose registry owner row is tenant-authored. The copy written is the object this kernel's own authoring door just saved, so the cross-project leakage the full bridge is gated against does not arise.
- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, the boot half (`bridgeRuntimeObjectsToMetadataService`).** On a kernel with an `environmentId` and `hydrateMetadataFromDb`, `start()` copies each hydrated runtime-authored object once, beside the existing bridge gate. `hydrateMetadataFromDb` is documented as set only on a kernel whose registry is its own. Only tenant-authored owner rows are copied, through `registerInMemory`, so a code package's objects reach the service from the artifact alone. The full boot bridge stays off on this shape. A copy that cannot land is logged once at `error`, naming the objects, the consequence and the way out. This is an `else if` on the existing bridge gate, after hydration; no step of `start()` moved.
- **Pins:** `packages/objectql/src/plugin-runtime-object-metadata-copy.test.ts` gains a describe for this shape. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-stdio-runtime-object-exposure.test.ts` runs its door suite on both shapes and gains one case. Both reuse the drivers already in those files, so no new double is added to any ledger.
- **`.changeset/23689-env-kernel-runtime-object-copy.md`:** a patch for `@objectstack/objectql`.

## Pins, and the ablation

**Producer pins** (real kernel, `createStandaloneStack`'s two options, the service's answers), new describe in `plugin-runtime-object-metadata-copy.test.ts`:
- created after boot with exposure off: a copy at once, saying `apiEnabled: false`;
- exposed, then turned off: the copy says so before the save returns;
- saved off, then a restart: the boot gives the hydrated object its copy;
- deleted: copy and listing entry gone;
- a code package's object gets no copy from the boot pass or from a runtime edit beside it.

**Door pins** (real kernel, real `MCPServerPlugin`, in-process JSON-RPC), `mcp-stdio-runtime-object-exposure.test.ts`, now `describe.each` over `no environmentId` and `environmentId env_local (createStandaloneStack)`:
- CONTROL: an exposed runtime object is listed, described, queried and written.
- Turned off after boot: `query_records`, `get_record`, `create_record`, `update_record` and `delete_record` are refused with `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` / 404, the table is untouched, and the exposed neighbour is still served.
- Created after boot with exposure off: refused from the first call.
- Saved off, then a restart: refused from the first call after the boot (new case).
- Deleted: not listed, describe says not found, and data verbs answer `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`.

The no-`environmentId` leg is the CONTROL that PR #23687's shape is unchanged.

**Ablations.** Every leg's mutation was proved on disk by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob changed. Every restore was proved too: blob equal to HEAD `3751a6c6161c`, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

| leg | mutation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectql 1 | the follow's `environmentId` early return put back | 4 failed, 6 passed. Red: created off, turned off, deleted, and the code-package pin's runtime-edit half. Green: the restart pin, which the boot pass covers, and the five no-`environmentId` pins. |
| objectql 2 | the boot pass's call replaced by a comment | 2 failed (the restart pin, and delete, whose precondition is the boot copy), 8 passed |
| door, mutant `dist/` | both mutations at once (the boot gate spelled `&& !String('ABLATION-23689-3b')` so it compiles), `objectql` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files | the `environmentId` shape: 5 failed. The no-`environmentId` shape: 5 passed. |
| door, restored | `objectql` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent`: marker absent from all 14 built files, tree clean | 10 passed |

The first door attempt deleted the boot pass's call outright. The `.d.ts` build refused the then-unused private method, so that leg never ran a test and its reading is void. It was redone with the compile-safe spelling above. The objectql pins import `plugin.ts` from source, so their legs need no rebuild.

## After the fix: the same walk on the real `os dev` (HTTP MCP door)

```
(a) created with apiEnabled:false   query_records / create_record   isError: "object is not exposed via the API"
(b) exposed, REST row, then off     query_records (exposed)         served; describe_object describes it (was "not found")
                                    after turn-off: query_records / create_record   isError: "object is not exposed via the API"
CONTROL exposed object              create_record served; list_objects names it (it did not before)
(c) deleted (DELETE /api/v1/meta/object/X)   query_records   OBJECT_NOT_FOUND 404
```

The HTTP door's refusal text carries no error code. That is #23528, which this PR does not address.

## Verification (at `94604ee5`, the last code commit; the gate list was re-derived there)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 426 files, 8145 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `plugin-runtime-object-metadata-copy.test.ts`: 10 passed. `mcp-stdio-runtime-object-exposure.test.ts` (against rebuilt `objectql` `dist/`): 10 passed.
- The exposure-gate suites: `@objectstack/mcp` `stdio-data-bridge.exposure.test.ts` plus `plugin.record-resource-exposure.test.ts` 35 passed, and `@objectstack/runtime` `action-execution-calldata-relation-target-exposure.test.ts` 13 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0, 0 errors. It was re-run after rebuilding the CLI closure with declarations.
- **Gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `94604ee51`, with no paths (4 paths against merge base `69351e985`), derives 68 families. All 68 were run and recorded with their exit codes. 64 exited 0 on the first pass. Four exited non-zero on that pass for reasons in this container, and each was re-run and exited 0:
  - `check-engine-split-ratio.mjs --days 90` (exit 2) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3) refused on a shallow clone. Each passed after `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-10 origin main`.
  - `check:dts-closure` (exit 1, 28 packages missing `.d.ts`) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, packages not built) came from my own walk-time `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` CLI build. Both passed after `turbo run build --force` over the CLI and CRM closure: `check:dts-closure` found 175 of 175 declaration files, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` probed 68 packages.
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: 68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. The derived list re-read at the same head is byte-identical.
- CI families beyond that list are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- **The real-CLI stdio leg was walked in-process, not through a spawned `os dev`.** The stdio transport would share the dev process's stdout with its banner. The in-process leg runs the same `MCPServerPlugin` stdio bridge over `createStandaloneStack`'s plugin options. Carrier: none.
- **The cloud runtime itself (`objectstack-ai/cloud`'s single-environment host) was not booted.** This session's repository scope is `objectstack-ai/objectstack`. Its in-repo shape is measured as described above. Carrier: none.
- **Exposed runtime objects on this shape were also missing from `list_objects` / `describe_object`.** That is the same absent copy, and it is fixed by the same change (see the after-walk). Noted, not filed.
